card.title: Nintendo Switch Overheating And Joycon Issues Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch Overheating And Joycon Issues Repair

claims.statement: Switch fan and Joy-Con rail power share a small MOSFET above M92T36; when it fails open the fan and Joy-Con charging stop. Tapping ~3 V into the fan line 2–3 times (console on, no Joy-Cons attached) usually revives it.
Otherwise suspect the fan, rail damage or corrosion; replace the MOSFET if injection fails.

procedure: Tap ~3 V into the fan line briefly 2–3 times.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
